prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Move to object, grab if possible, then move to designated spot if heavy or fragile, or do specific task. list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGraspable    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFragile    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesignatedSpot    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectCarefullyToDesignatedSpot    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificSubTree    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectGraspable? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	END
